name: payment.sent
title: Payment sent
description: A SEP-41 token transfer, viewed from the sender's side. Scoped to the interface rather than to individual tokens because the `transfer` event is defined by SEP-41 itself, so every conforming token emits the same shape. `trailingTopics` is "allowed" because CAP-67 appends an `asset` topic when the token is a Stellar Asset Contract, which a pure contract token does not have. Mirrors the `payment.sent` name @orbital-stellar/pulse-core already uses for the sender's view of a Horizon payment - the same event from the recipient's side is a separate entry for `payment.received`.

from.doc: Account or contract the tokens left.

to.doc: Account or contract the tokens arrived at.

amount.doc: Amount in the token's base units. SEP-41 puts the amount in the data payload as a bare i128, so there is no `path`.

direction.doc: Fixed: this entry is the sender's view of the transfer.
